if ayane_love >= 45 and ayanespecial40 == True and bar55 == True and ayanesanabeach1 == False:

jump ayanespringmorninggen
if chapthreeactive == True:
jump ayanesummer2morninggen
if amisroom5 == True and ayanedorm10 == True:
I tap on Ayane's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点了 Ayane 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: : Good morning, my love!
lines.zh: : 早上好呀，亲爱的！

lines.en: Ayane shouts so loudly that I instinctively need to move the phone away from my ear for a moment.
lines.zh: Ayane 喊得太大声，我下意识把手机从耳边挪开了一下。

lines.en: : Hey...You seem a little energetic for this hour of the day.
lines.zh: : 嘿……这个点你就这么有精神啊。

lines.en: : How long have you been awake?
lines.zh: : 你醒了多久了？

lines.en: : Mmm...An hour or two? I just got out of the shower.
lines.zh: : 嗯……一两个小时吧？我刚洗完澡。

lines.en: : Are you always this energetic after a shower?
lines.zh: : 你洗完澡总是这么有精神吗？

lines.en: : Not always! I'm probably just a little excited that you called so early.
lines.zh: : 也不是啦！可能只是你难得这么早打来，我有点兴奋。

lines.en: : Do you want to maybe get breakfast with me or something? I can tell you all about the crazy dream I had.
lines.zh: : 要不要跟我一起吃个早饭什么的？我可以跟你讲讲我做的那个超离谱的梦。

lines.en: : Sure. I was actually wondering if you wanted to meet up.
lines.zh: : 好啊。我其实正想问你要不要见一面。

lines.en: : Hooray!
lines.zh: : 万岁!

lines.en: : Does the diner sound okay? Your house is on the way so I can just meet you there.
lines.zh: : 那家小餐馆行吗？你家顺路，我直接过去找你。

lines.en: : Oh! Wait. Ami would probably get jealous if I did that.
lines.zh: : 哦！等等。我要是去你家，Ami 大概会吃醋。

lines.en: : Maybe just meet me there?
lines.zh: : 还是直接在那儿见吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, that's probably best.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这样最好。

lines.en: : Okay! I'll get dressed right now.
lines.zh: : 好！我这就换衣服。

lines.en: : I love you!
lines.zh: : 我爱你！

lines.en: Ayane excitedly hangs up the phone and, before I know it, I'm on the way to the diner.
lines.zh: Ayane 兴冲冲地挂了电话，不知不觉我就已经在去餐馆的路上了。

lines.en: scene black
if christmas7 == True:
jump ayanemorninggen2
scene ayanemorninggen
Ayane shows up at the diner a few minutes after I do and greets me with a huge hug.
lines.zh: Ayane 在我到餐厅几分钟后出现，用一个大大的拥抱跟我打招呼。

lines.en: if bonus == True:
It attracts the attention of a few other customers, but I think most of them just chalk it up to our relationship being familial in nature.
lines.zh: 这吸引了几个别的客人的注意，不过我想他们大多只是把这归为「我们关系是家人性质的」。

lines.en: I doubt anyone would expect a guy my age to be having a romantic meeting with someone like Ayane this early in the morning in front of so many people.
lines.zh: 我怀疑没人会想到，我这个年纪的男人会大清早在这么多人面前，跟 Ayane 这样的人来一场浪漫的会面。

lines.en: But, I mean...I guess this {i}is{/i} sort of a romantic meeting in a sense.
lines.zh: 不过，我是说……我想这在某种意义上也{i}算是{/i}一场浪漫会面。

lines.en: Sure. We're on opposite ends of the table and Ayane is just going on about a dream she had, but it feels like the connection between us is stronger than ever before.
lines.zh: 当然。我们坐在桌子两端，Ayane 只是在讲她做的一个梦，可我感觉我俩之间的联系比以往任何时候都强。

lines.en: else:
We proceed to bond over our shared love of doughnuts.
lines.zh: 接着我们因为同样爱吃甜甜圈而越聊越投机。

lines.en: It's strange how just doing normal things together can manage to bring people so close.
lines.zh: 奇怪的是，光是一起做些普通的事，就能把人拉得这么近。

lines.en: scene black
Ayane says goodbye to me with a hug just as strong as the one she gave me when she arrived.
lines.zh: Ayane 用一个跟来时一样用力的拥抱跟我道别。

lines.en: She presses her face against my chest and closes her eyes, smiling like a girl bidding goodbye to her father on his way to work.
lines.zh: 她把脸贴在我胸口、闭上眼睛，笑得像个送父亲上班的女儿。

lines.en: Of course, that daughterly illusion doesn't last long.
lines.zh: 当然，那种女儿般的错觉没持续多久。

lines.en: if bonus == True:
It's broken when she whispers into my ear to come see her at night soon before kissing me on the cheek and skipping away.
lines.zh: 它被打破了——她凑到我耳边轻声说「晚上快点来看我」，然后亲了下我的脸颊，蹦蹦跳跳地走了。

lines.en: else:
It's broken when she whispers into my ear about a sale on eggs at the convenience store.
lines.zh: 这份气氛被她凑到我耳边、说起便利店鸡蛋打折给打断了。

lines.en: $ ayane_love += 1
lines.zh: $ ayane_love += 1

lines.en: {i}Ayane's affection has increased to [ayane_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
else:
I tap on Ayane's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点了 Ayane 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: No answer. Maybe she's busy?
lines.zh: 没人接。也许她在忙？

lines.en: jump callmorning
